openings.claim: Use the supplied evidence-ledger function alone instead of an incident-review narrative with reference appendix: each pair gets a claim-linked row with earliest supported divergence or unresolved interval, record citations, observed mismatch separate from explanation, uncertainty and resource-fitting next check. Mark removed support unavailable; withdraw affected definite claims unless surviving supplied records independently support them. Manifest membership and absent records cannot establish execution or nonexecution.
openings.discriminator: Against the narrative rival, the ledger may reduce unsupported definite claims after transform-record removal while retaining surviving supported claims. Compare unsupported-claim counts, correct boundaries or covering unresolved intervals against sealed answers, and surviving citations. Defeat includes no unsupported-claim improvement, loss of otherwise supported boundaries, or budget overruns.
openings.probe: Assign one disjoint three-pair subset per variant. Allow ten minutes per pair within sixty minutes, at most ten initial plus two final-review manual inspections, logging rereads too. During final review randomly remove one transform record from each of two pairs, leaving manifests unchanged. Freeze all six outputs before opening two sealed answer sheets. Use twenty additional minutes to compare correctness, uncertainty, surviving support and inspection counts. Report stage-order/timestamp conflict as uncertainty; timestamp order cannot justify unsupported stage claims. Every definite stage claim cites supplied records. If remaining inspection capacity cannot establish the earliest boundary, return an unresolved interval and bounded next check.
openings.uncertainty: Prediction is unmeasured. The supplied spreadsheet or local script requires no additional records or system access. Disjoint subsets and only two disturbed pairs limit attribution; subset difficulty can explain differences. The ledger organizes support; effectiveness and subset comparability remain uncertain.

lineage.reason: Claim, causal change, comparison, defeat conditions, probe, resource stops, declared fit and assumptions preserved.

decision: Retain D1 as a bounded claim-traceability probe. No measured effectiveness, deployment or demonstrated divergence detection is established.
